description: Data import capability benchmark. Tests a model's ability to write data converters, generate reference.json metadata, and handle data prep tasks from the DaedalMap pipeline.

scoring.converter_runs: Generated Python script executes without error (exit code 0)
scoring.converter_correct: Output parquet has correct row count, loc_id first, all metrics float64, no dupes
scoring.reference_metrics_complete: Every parquet metric column has a metrics entry
scoring.reference_aggregation: Every metric has an aggregation rule
scoring.keyword_coverage: Keywords include expected synonyms (scored as 1 - gaps/total_expected)
scoring.schema_understanding: Model correctly identifies column types, geographic level, loc_id format

converter.description: Test converter script generation. Model writes a Python script that transforms raw CSV to parquet.

DataFrame dtypes after pd.read_csv():
loc_id       object
year         int64

co2          float64
co2_pct      object   # has '%' suffix: '12.5%'
